verdict.rationale: The product does run one recurring background task on its own: it files annual reports automatically in every state as they come due, through direct secretary-of-state integrations. The evidence shows no user-defined automation builder, triggers, or scheduling. Customizable reminders, profile-update propagation, and the OAuth client-credentials API are adjacent features or developer building blocks, so they earn no credit. Missing for 10: user-configurable automation or workflow setup, custom triggers or schedules, automations beyond annual-report filing, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background

citations.quote: We file annual reports automatically in all states as they come due.
